const monthly = {}; // { "2026-05": { s1: { dc: n, nights: n, wknd: n }, ... } }
            const allMonths = new Set();
            Object.entries(schedule).forEach(([mStr, wk]) => {
              const mon = parse(mStr);
              for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
                const d = addD(mon, i);
                const moKey = `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")}`;
                allMonths.add(moKey);
                if (!monthly[moKey]) monthly[moKey] = {};
                surgeons.forEach(s => { if (!monthly[moKey][s.id]) monthly[moKey][s.id] = { dc:0, nights:0, wknd:0 }; });
              }
              // Skip backup weeks entirely — they're 2nd-call and not billed
              if (wk.isBackup) return;
              if (wk.dayCall) {
                // Each of the 7 service-week days credits its own calendar month.
                // Honor single-day service-coverage overrides so a covered day is
                // billed to the covering surgeon, not the week's service surgeon.
                for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
                  const d = addD(mon, i);
                  const ds = fmt(d);
                  const dMoKey = `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")}`;
                  const svcSid = (wk.dayCallOverrides && wk.dayCallOverrides[ds]) || wk.dayCall;
                  if (monthly[dMoKey]?.[svcSid]) monthly[dMoKey][svcSid].dc += 1;
                }
              }
              NIGHT_KEYS.forEach((sk, i) => {
                const sid = wk.nights?.[sk];
                if (!sid) return;
                const d = addD(mon, i);
                const moKey = `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")}`;
                if (monthly[moKey]?.[sid]) monthly[moKey][sid].nights += 1;
              });
              const wkndSid = wk.nights?.wknd;
              if (wkndSid) {
                // Weekend covers Fri/Sat/Sun (days 4/5/6 of the week), each crediting its own month
                for (let i = 4; i <= 6; i++) {
                  const d = addD(mon, i);
                  const dMoKey = `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")}`;
                  if (monthly[dMoKey]?.[wkndSid]) monthly[dMoKey][wkndSid].wknd += 1;
                }
              }
            });
